name: Unitree R1-A
summary: A stationary dual-arm upper body of 11 to 13 kg with 5- or 7-axis arms carrying 2 to 4 kg each and a choice of gripper or three- or five-finger hands, for bench-top handling and manipulation research.

germany.statusNote: Not orderable yet. Terra Robotics (DE) lists R1-A5 and R1-A7 versions with net EUR prices, but every version is marked 'Auf Anfrage' (on request) and none can be put in the cart. quadruped.de shows 'price on request, available from 15.02.2027', and Unitree's own store shows the R1-A5 at USD 4,290 but marks it unavailable.

priceEur.note: Terra Robotics, R1-A5 Smart A (Dex1-1 gripper), excl. VAT. R1-A5 Smart: EUR 7,548.17 to 20,072.05 net; R1-A7 Smart: 8,225.14 to 20,749.02. Price depends on the hand option. All versions shown as on request.

specs.label: Weight
specs.conditions: R1-A7, approx., with external power supply; R1-A5 approx. 11 kg

specs.label: Total DOF
specs.conditions: R1-A7 with gripper; R1-A5 15. Unitree states 15 to 31 depending on end effector; Terra lists 31 for R1-A7 with Dex3-1 hands.

specs.label: Max payload per arm
specs.conditions: stated as 2 to 4 kg; varies strongly with arm extension posture

specs.label: Battery life
specs.conditions: approx., when battery-powered; external power also supported

specs.label: Compute
specs.value: Head: 8-core CPU + 10 TOPS; body: 8-core CPU; optional module such as Orin 40-100 TOPS
specs.conditions: Terra Smart versions include a 40 TOPS dock

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Binocular camera (146 x 124 deg FOV), optional wrist camera, 4-mic array, dual speakers

specs.label: End effectors
specs.value: Two-finger gripper, three-finger or five-finger dexterous hand
specs.conditions: chosen per order; Terra lists 8 versions (Dex1-1 gripper, Dex3-1, Revo 2, Linker Hand O6, tendon hand)

specs.label: Development
specs.value: Open interfaces for underlying system, arms, audio, lighting and vision; OTA updates

notes: Fixed base: it does not move on its own; Unitree sells the mobile version as R1-A-D.
Arm payload is a maximum of 2 to 4 kg that drops with arm extension; no rated value published.
The end effector is chosen per order: the cheapest Terra version has a two-finger gripper, others have three- or five-finger hands.
Unitree warns users to keep a safe distance from the arms; no safety certification or IP rating is published.
